Fragments of the Epic Cycle

The Story of Oedipus

1.
… the 
Story of Oedipus
 by Cinaethon in six thousand six hundred verses.
2.
Judging by Homer I do not believe that Oedipus had children by Iocasta: his sons were born of Euryganeia as the writer of the Epic called the 
Story of Oedipus
 clearly shows.
3.
The authors of the 
Story of Oedipus
 (say) of the Sphinx: “But furthermore (she killed) noble Haemon, the dear son of blameless Creon, the comeliest and loveliest of boys.”
